findings.title: Validate the reporting profile before accepting the sitemap Blob
findings.body: generateSitemapBundle validates mode/engine/count/hash syntax and later recomputes SHA(identity), but does not validate identity.directive_reporting. A JSON profile with version999 and non-boolean flags, or allfalse inactive flags, can pass with a recomputed matching digest and coherent counts. MCP reporting_header parses strict DirectiveReportingConfig and requires validate()+active(), so this shared frontdoor is weaker than the promised typed profile contract. No malformed-response runtime call was performed.

counterexample.guards: All displayed predicates can pass; provide SHA256 of exact JSON.stringify(identity) and syntactically valid ordinal digests.

findings.suggested_fix: Match the strict typed profile boundary in UI: required version1/exact boolean fields, null for absence or an active strict profile; reject malformed extra/missing/inactive object profiles before download. Add source-bound malformed-profile and valid-profile async download-path regressions. Preserve count/hash/mode/EOF/owner guards.

scope: Independent source/JSON/hash/fullpair/inverse + nonempty Node stdin grammar only; current441 composition. No target import/eval/VM/compiler/test/native/browser/HTTP/SQL/DB/PE/C/R/private/Git/process inspection/commonlock.
